	<ResortReportHeadline>Make the most of the morning!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It's a dramatic looking sky this morning with some high cloud blowing through which is forecast to increase as a change approaches from the west.</p><p>The current temp is +1.3, headed for a top of +3 degrees. Right now, the wind is strong from the north and is expected to impact operations on the upper lifts. Please check the Lift Status Page and Hotham App for real-time updates.</p><p>Even though the temps stayed above zero all night the snow has had a freeze and will start out firm before softening as the day warms or as any precipitation begins to fall. With blobs showing on the radar to our west, today will definitely be a day to get out there sooner rather than later to try and beat the incoming weather.</p><p>The groomers will be the best bet first up with just enough texture to get your edges in, and off piste should come into shape for fun turns later as the surface becomes more forgiving.</p><p>Get out there early for the best of it.&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
